prompt:
This file is prompt-only policy for Seed command metadata. Use shell, jq, and edit. Write <install>/agent-store/seed-agent/commands.json. Internal command records are English-only. Do not add API tools, a TUI, or a wrapper.

TABLE
Create /help, /tools, /models, /skills, /packs, /pack, and /refine entries, each {name,description,use}. description is one-line English ASCII. use is concise English policy, not executable code. /packs, /packs install <slug>, and /pack <slug> are runtime commands; never replace them with a curl or jq pipeline.

READS
/help reads commands.json. /tools lists separately: (1) API tools shell and edit, (2) ok identity.prereqs required by the runtime, and (3) ok capabilities from the Machine index. Resources are known off-machine references, not callable tools. /models reads models.json. /skills reads Machine index agent.skills.

REFINE
/refine reviews recent .agent-runs evidence and writes small English project-memory notes or facts to $PWD/.agent-memory/index.json. Entry shape is {title,kind,text or path,source,utc,ok:true}; kinds are lesson, preference, decision, and fact. Inline text is at most 280 characters; longer text uses .agent-memory/notes/<slug>.md and a relative path. Before mutation, snapshot index.json under .agent-memory/snapshots/<utc>.json. Dedupe by title and supersede rather than duplicate. If notes plus facts exceed 50, merge before adding. Every project-memory mutation holds agent-store/.state.lock and uses a unique same-directory validated temporary file plus rename. Never store keys, sk- strings, credentials, /Users/ or /home/ absolute paths, source dumps, or one-off task state.

CHECKS
1) The table is valid JSON and includes all seven commands.
2) It has no prompt field.
3) Every description is one-line English ASCII.
4) Uses mention: commands.json for /help; Machine index for /tools; models.json for /models; agent.skills for /skills; core /packs for /packs and /pack; .agent-memory/index.json, snapshots, entry shape, supersede, shared lock, and deny list for /refine.
If any check fails, leave ours.seed_agent.commands unset.
